  Observe row_scene at scriveners_row when not dark() and not visitedBefore(scriveners_row) "The Lettered Quarter smells of wet pulp and lamp-black. The Row is all stalls: scriveners at sloped desks under awnings, writing letters for those who cannot, contracts for those who can, and arguing with both. Reed-paper hangs drying from every balcony like laundry. At the north end, the Office of Seals has a queue outside it that goes round the corner and, people say, has not been shorter in living memory. Opposite, the Exchequer is a narrow house with barred windows and one lit lamp.".
  Observe row_scene_again at scriveners_row when not dark() and visitedBefore(scriveners_row) "Scriveners' Row: stalls and sloped desks, paper drying on the balconies, the queue at the Office of Seals, the Exchequer's one lit window.".
  Observe row_night at scriveners_row when dark() "The stalls are shuttered and the paper taken in. The Office of Seals is dark. In the Exchequer one window is lit, as it is every night.".

  // The Terraces: the old houses, above the flood line.
  Observe terraces_scene at terraces when not visitedBefore(terraces) "The ground rises here to the city's one hill, and the old houses of the Moieties stand along it in terraces of walled garden (three of them claim descent from the Aenean magistrates, and have the portraits to prove it, all painted in the last century), with salt-bitten fig trees and doors painted the colours of their families. The Council House has a portico and a bell. Further along, a tall house with a soldier on its steps is where the city keeps the King of Hethra, courteously, until his ransom is paid.".
  Observe terraces_scene_again at terraces when visitedBefore(terraces) "The Terraces: walled gardens, painted doors, the Council House with its bell, the King's lodging with its soldier on the steps.".

  // Panhythe and the Pans.
  Observe saltgate_scene at saltgate when not dark() and not visitedBefore(saltgate) "Panhythe is the city's working end: carts, sacks, a smell of brine and peat-smoke. Factor Sault's countinghouse has a brass plate polished like a mirror. Beside it her warehouses run back to the water, and next to those is a long hall with its doors open and a crowd of men in old red coats outside it, waiting to be picked for the day's work.".
  Observe saltgate_scene_again at saltgate when not dark() and visitedBefore(saltgate) "Panhythe: carts and brine, the Factor's brass plate, red coats waiting outside the hiring hall.".
  Observe saltgate_night at saltgate when dark() "The countinghouse is shuttered. A lantern burns over the warehouse door, and under it two of Factor Sault's men are playing dice on a salt-sack.".
  Observe pans_scene at pans when true "East of the city the salt-pans run out into the marsh in a chequer of shallow squares, white at the edges, each with its sluice. Women in wooden pattens rake the crust. Steam rises from the boiling-houses. The tide that comes through the Swatch runs out here too, under the dykes, and what it carries out it leaves: weed, timber, a shoe.".

  // ── Buildings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Place teazle_house "Nan Teazle's house" is building within tessary.
  Place teazle_room "Nan Teazle's house" is room within teazle_house at 0, 0.
  Passage teazle_ladder "the Teazles' ladder" is steps between withies and teazle_room.
  Observe teazle_scene at teazle_room when true "One room on stilts, and everything in it hung up out of the damp: eel-traps, nets, a smoked side of something, a soldier's coat on a peg that nobody wears. A brazier, a bed in a cupboard, a shelf of crockery and on it, in a frame, a recruiting bill eleven years old: LAND AND A PENSION FOR EVERY MAN WHO COMES HOME.".

  Place drum_house "the Muffled Drum" is building within tessary.
  Place drum_taproom "the Muffled Drum's taproom" is room within drum_house at 0, 0.
  Passage drum_door "the Drum's door" is door between withies and drum_taproom.
  Observe drum_scene at drum_taproom when not visitedBefore(drum_taproom) "A low taproom built out over the backwater, so that the floor moves a little when the tide is running. Soldiers' coats on every peg, soldiers' boots under every bench. Over the bar hangs a regimental drum with a black cloth tied over its head.".
  Observe drum_scene_again at drum_taproom when visitedBefore(drum_taproom) "The Muffled Drum: soldiers' coats on every peg, the floor shifting a little with the tide.".
  Observe drum_noise at drum_taproom when not dark() "It is loud in here, and the noise is the noise of men who have nothing to do: dice, an argument about pay, someone telling the story of Sedge Ford for the hundredth time and getting it wrong.".

  Place countinghouse "Factor Sault's countinghouse" is building within tessary.
  Place sault_office "Factor Sault's countinghouse" is room within countinghouse at 0, 0.
  Passage countinghouse_door "the countinghouse door" is door between saltgate and sault_office.
  Observe office_scene at sault_office when true "Clerks at high desks, a stove, a wall of pigeonholes, a salt-crusted map of the delta with the Factor's ships pinned on it. A cone of hot eels in paper sits on the ledgers, half eaten.".

  Place warehouse "Sault's warehouse" is building within tessary.
  Place warehouse_floor "the warehouse floor" is room within warehouse at 0, 0.
  Place warehouse_below "the warehouse cellars" is level within warehouse.
  Place cistern "the old cistern" is room within warehouse_below at 0, 0.
  Passage warehouse_door "the warehouse door" is door between saltgate and warehouse_floor.
  Passage cistern_stair "the cistern stair" is stair between warehouse_floor and cistern.
  Observe warehouse_scene at warehouse_floor when true "Salt in sacks to the rafters, stacked in blocks with lanes between, and a smell that dries your mouth. At the back, behind a stack that has not been moved in a long while, a trap-door with a ring.".
  Observe cistern_scene at cistern when true "A vaulted cistern, older than the warehouse over it, dry now, its floor scuffed into paths. A tunnel goes off northward, low and wet, toward the sea; there are lamp-hooks along it.".

  Place muster_house "Sault's Muster" is building within tessary.
  Place muster_hall "Sault's Muster" is room within muster_house at 0, 0.
  Passage muster_door "the hiring hall door" is doorway between saltgate and muster_hall.
  Person hiring_clerk "Sault's hiring clerk" at muster_hall {
    Role "who keeps the book of the Factor's Muster". Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns he. Manner stoic.
    Greets "The hiring clerk looks up from the book and holds his pen ready over a new line, in case you are a soldier.".
  }
  Topic clerk_book with hiring_clerk "Ask the hiring clerk who is on the Factor's books" when true once {
    Says "'Forty-one this morning,' says the clerk, and turns the book round so you can see. The names go down in a clear round hand, and six of them have been struck through with a ruler, neatly, each with a date beside it in the margin, each date a spring ebb. 'The Factor says strike them through when they go,' he says. 'Not out. Through. So the name can still be read.'".
  }
  Topic clerk_night with hiring_clerk "Ask the hiring clerk about the night work" when true once {
    Says "'Carrying,' says the clerk. 'Down under the warehouse at the ebb, for Mistress Slake. Double pay, and the Factor's word nobody asks.' He dips his pen. 'I don't write those in the book. I'm not asked to.'".
  }
  Observe muster_scene at muster_hall when true "A long bare hall with benches down both walls and a table at the end where a clerk writes names in a book. Over the table, in new paint: SAULT'S MUSTER. A DAY'S PAY FOR A DAY'S WORK. NO MAN TURNED AWAY WHO WORE THE COAT.".

  Place seals_house "the Office of Seals" is building within tessary.
  Place seals_hall "the hall of the Office of Seals" is room within seals_house at 0, 0.
  Place seals_inner "the Keeper's room" is room within seals_house at 1, 0.
  Passage seals_door "the Office door" is doorway between scriveners_row and seals_hall.
  Passage seals_grille "the Keeper's grille" is door between seals_hall and seals_inner.
  Observe seals_scene at seals_hall when true "A high hall with a rail across it and the queue folded back and forth along the rail like a rope in a locker. Everybody in it is holding a document. At the head of the queue, behind a grille, a door.".
  Observe inner_scene at seals_inner when true "A small panelled room with no window. On a table under a glass bell lies the Great Seal of Tessary, a disc of dark bronze the size of a plate, and beside it the wax, the ribbon, the ledger of everything ever sealed.".

  Place exchequer_house "the Exchequer" is building within tessary.
  Place exchequer_room "the Treasurer's room" is room within exchequer_house at 0, 0.
  Passage exchequer_door "the Exchequer door" is door between scriveners_row and exchequer_room.
  Observe exchequer_scene at exchequer_room when true "A narrow room at the top of a narrow house, all ledgers. The strongboxes along the wall stand open, and are empty, and have been for some time; dust lies inside them. A cot behind a screen. A bottle.".

  Place pounce_house "Pounce's stall" is building within tessary.
  Place pounce_stall "Pounce's stall" is room within pounce_house at 0, 0.
  Passage pounce_door "Pounce's door" is doorway between scriveners_row and pounce_stall.
  Observe pounce_scene at pounce_stall when true "A scrivener's shop the width of a cupboard, with a sloped desk in the window, pens in a jar of sand, and every surface papered with drafts. A notice: CONTRACTS DRAWN. CONTRACTS READ. CONTRACTS EXPLAINED (EXTRA).".

  Place council_house "the Council House" is building within tessary.
  Place council_chamber "the council chamber" is room within council_house at 0, 0.
  Passage council_door "the Council House door" is door between terraces and council_chamber.
  Observe chamber_empty at council_chamber when not inSession() and not voted(ossel) "Between sittings nobody is here but a boy filling the inkwells at each seat. A bill by the door gives the next: the thirteenth day, from ten in the morning, the question of the Veterans' Settlement, the public bench open.".
  Observe chamber_scene at council_chamber when true "A round chamber with a ring of carved seats, one for each Moiety: Salt, Paper, Rope, Eel, Ship, and the three old houses. On the wall behind the Speaker's chair hangs the war's banner, and under it a painting of the Kneeling at Sedge Ford, in which King Amaury of Hethra is very small and the Tessarine captain very large.".

  Place kings_house "the King's lodging" is building within tessary.
  Place kings_rooms "the King's rooms" is room within kings_house at 0, 0.
  Passage kings_door "the King's door" is door between terraces and kings_rooms.
  Observe kings_scene at kings_rooms when true "Good rooms, kept by a city that wants to be seen to keep its prisoner well: a fire, books, a window on the sea. A board of Hethran draughts is set out by the fire with a game half played. The guard on the steps sits outside the door, not in.".

  Place marrable_house "Councillor Marrable's house" is building within tessary.
  Place marrable_room "Councillor Marrable's house" is room within marrable_house at 0, 0.
  Passage marrable_door "Marrable's door" is door between terraces and marrable_room.
  Observe marrable_scene at marrable_room when true "A small house of the Terraces, the smallest, with no garden to speak of. Inside it is a soldier's house: everything square, everything put away. On a table, a pile of papers weighted down with a pistol-butt with no pistol.".

  Place chapel_house "Saint Evenhand's" is building within tessary.
  Place chapel "Saint Evenhand's chapel" is room within chapel_house at 0, 0.
  Passage chapel_door "the chapel door" is doorway between landgate and chapel.
  Observe chapel_scene at chapel when true "A whitewashed chapel the size of a boat-shed. Over the altar the saint is painted holding a pair of scales level, very carefully, with the face of someone who has been asked to hold them for a long time. Votive weights hang on cords from the ceiling, brass and lead and stone, hundreds of them, each the weight of a promise someone wanted kept.".

  Place chandlery_house "Pitch's chandlery" is building within tessary.
  Place chandlery "Pitch's chandlery" is room within chandlery_house at 0, 0.
  Passage chandlery_door "the chandlery door" is door between landgate and chandlery.
  Observe chandlery_scene at chandlery when true "Rope, tar, lanterns, oilskins, hooks, rations in tins, and a ship's chandler in a leather apron behind a counter worn into a dip by elbows.".
}
data/adventures/what-tessary-owes/growth:
Module tessary "What Tessary Owes" {
  // ── What a company grows by here ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Experience for what is found out and what is done, not only for what is fought: a thorough fortnight in Tessary is
  // worth two levels or a little more to someone who came in at the first.
  Milestone m_held "found out where the called go" worth 250 when knows(party, held_alive).
  Milestone m_terms "read the terms of the War Note" worth 300 when knows(party, note_terms).
  Milestone m_weight "worked out what would pay the War Note" worth 250 when knows(party, promise_weight).
  Milestone m_compact "read the drowned city's compact" worth 300 when knows(party, compact_read).
  Milestone m_letter "read the Factor's letter" worth 300 when knows(party, sault_bid).
  Milestone m_below "went down into the Strongrooms" worth 400 when at(party, antechamber).
  Milestone m_designed "found out why the War Note was drawn" worth 600 when knows(party, note_designed).
  Milestone m_goose "brought Mistress Plum home" worth 150 when plumHome(ossel).
  Milestone m_durrance "kept Sergeant Durrance from the sea" worth 400 when night(ossel) >= 8 and not heldNow(durrance) and (heldBack(durrance) or durranceSpared(ossel) or durranceKnowsFraud(durrance)).
  Milestone m_riot "kept the Muster off the Terraces" worth 300 when riotCalmed(ossel) or night(ossel) >= 13 and fiskTurned(fisk) and not riotHappened(ossel).
  Milestone m_vote "saw the Settlement carried" worth 500 when votePassed(ossel).
  Milestone m_seal "kept the Great Seal" worth 250 when sealRaidFoiled(ossel) or sealTried(ossel) and not sealStolen(ossel) and night(ossel) >= 14.
  Milestone m_marrable "kept Councillor Marrable from harm" worth 200 when attemptFoiled(ossel) or attemptMade(ossel) and not marrableHurt(ossel) and night(ossel) >= 11.
  Milestone m_quire "gave the Treasurer a reason to live" worth 300 when quireHope(quire).
  Milestone m_deeds "put the deeds into the hands of the called" worth 800 when deedsDelivered(ossel).
  Milestone m_release "stood with the Muster at the Oath Stone" worth 800 when released(ossel).
  Milestone m_assembly "testified before the Assembly of the Scruples" worth 700 when assemblyHeard(ossel).
  Milestone m_warden "made the Factor a Warden" worth 500 when saultWarden(ossel).
  Milestone m_davy "brought Davy Teazle home" worth 300 when cameHome(davy) and at(davy, teazle_room).
}
data/adventures/wrayford/city.kyr:
Module wrayford "The Third Night" {
  Description "Wrayford, a bridge-city where the drove roads cross the Wray, in the three days after the lord's riders hanged three carters from the gatehouse rail: a city of carters, aldermen, ferrymen and printers, a toll nobody wants and everybody is making money from, and a widow who will bury her husband before the third night is out.".

  // ── The vale ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The drove roads come down off the fells to the one bridge in forty miles. The city proper is on the north bank;
  // across nineteen arches, the Liberty of Overbridge, which has been Saint Wade's since before there was a bridge.
  Place imbar "Imbar" is plane.
  Place wray "the vale of the Wray" is region within imbar.
  Initially Assert terrain(wray, hills).
  Place fells_edge "the fell road" is wilderness within wray at 1, 0.
  Place wrayford "Wrayford" is settlement within wray at 1, 1.
  Place bridge "Wrayford Bridge" is site within wray at 1, 2.
  Place overbridge "Overbridge" is settlement within wray at 1, 3.
  Place south_country "the south road" is wilderness within wray at 1, 4.

  // ── Buildings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Module wrayford "The Third Night" {
  // ── What a company grows by here ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Experience for what is resolved, found out, carried and decided; not for what is killed.
  Milestone m_bramble "brought Wat Pardoe's dog home" worth 150 when brambleHome(bramble).
  Milestone m_hide "judged the hide in the Abbess's court" worth 150 when hideJudged(wray).
  Milestone m_hide_wise "found the hide's true owner" worth 150 when hideFor(ham).
  Milestone m_robin "settled the bear-ward's boy" worth 200 when robinHome(robin) or robinStays(robin).
  Milestone m_win "helped Win Fenner without shaming her" worth 200 when winHelped(party).
  Milestone m_tools "brought Dunstan Fenner's chisels home" worth 150 when toolsHome(win).
  Milestone m_portrait "saw the Company painted as it is" worth 200 when state(portrait, true_likeness) or portraitBanner(wray) or portraitHung(wray).
  Milestone m_pinch "had a ruling out of Amos Pinch" worth 150 when ruling(ruled_carcass) or ruling(ruled_tithe) or pinchFlustered(pinch).
  Milestone m_clause "moved a clause the Bench passed" worth 300 when clauseCharity(wray) or clauseRelease(wray) or clauseAudit(wray).
  Milestone m_print "printed a broadside of your own" worth 200 when printed(sheet_trial) or printed(sheet_fire) or printed(sheet_elegy).
  Milestone m_ring "put Joss Wilder's ring on Annis Pye's hand" worth 250 when annisRing(annis).
  Milestone m_ice "brought ice to the toll-keeper's house" worth 200 when jennetIced(jennet).
  Milestone m_corbin "brought Corbin and Dorcas Mudd to speak to each other" worth 300 when reconciled(wray).
  Milestone m_ford "crossed the old ford" worth 200 when knows(party, ford_way) and at(party, tanyards).
  Milestone m_fire "found out who burned the toll-house" worth 400 when knows(party, fire_pinch).
  Milestone m_reins "found out who was driving" worth 300 when knows(party, kit_reins).
  Milestone m_kit "heard Kit's confession" worth 400 when knows(party, kit_driving).
  Milestone m_letter "found out who sent the riders" worth 400 when knows(party, hal_wrote).
  Milestone m_kit_down "kept Kit from the counting-house" worth 300 when kitStoodDown(kit) or kitTurned(kit).
  Milestone m_claim "had the Abbess claim the dead" worth 250 when abbessClaims(abbess).
  Milestone m_mothers "brought the two widows together" worth 500 when mothersMet(wray).
  Milestone m_captain "spoke to the captain for Wrayford" worth 300 when captainView(sefton) >= 1.
  Milestone m_buried "saw the three buried" worth 600 when buried(wat_dead) and buried(dunstan_dead) and buried(joss_dead).
}

{
  "about": "What a town's shrine holds about a deep site's seal, and the ways a company may argue it out, each tried once (src/world/deep/deep-argument.ts binds it into each deep site that has a seal and a town with a priest). In what is said, {priest} is the priest, said by their name; {name} is the deep site's name; {noun} is what the seal is asked about (the walled stair), {opened} what it opens, {cut} what is cut on it, {carry} what the shrine would have the company take below. In a move, needs is what it asks besides the priest's having spoken, check the roll it is (a skill and how hard), won whether it wins the priest over, learn a fact it teaches ({grief}: the priest's grief), caught whether a failed try shuts the shrine to the company, always whether even a won try does; {bane} is the fact of the keeper's bane.",
  "grief": "{priest}'s brother went down into {name} and did not come back up. What {priest} says of {opened} is grief as much as doctrine.",
  "ask": "Ask {priest} about {noun} in {name}",
  "stand": "'The makers shut {opened} themselves,' says {priest}, 'and they knew what they were doing. What they shut in, they shut in for all of us. Open it, and I will not pray for you, nor heal you, nor sit up with your dead.'",
  "again": "Ask {priest} again about {noun}",
  "careful": "'Go carefully,' says {priest}.",
  "carry": " 'And take {carry} with you, if you find it.'",
  "told": "Then {priest} tells you what the shrine has always kept of it: {bane_said}",
  "moves": [
    { "id": "evidence", "label": "Tell {priest} what {cut} say", "needs": "knows(actor, {bane})", "check": "persuasion, dc_easy", "won": true,
      "yes": "{priest} hears the words out, and is quiet for a while. 'If the makers wrote that, they meant it to be read,' {priest} says at last. 'And meant someone to go down with the light.'",
      "no": "{priest} hears the words out, and is not moved. 'Words cut in stone,' says {priest}. 'Anyone can cut words.'" },
    { "id": "argue", "label": "Argue with {priest} that what is below should be met, not walled in", "check": "persuasion, dc_hard", "won": true,
      "yes": "{priest} argues it with you point by point, and gives way on the last one. 'Then go,' says {priest}, 'but go as if it mattered.'",
      "no": "{priest} argues it with you point by point, and gives way on none of them." },
    { "id": "read", "label": "Watch {priest} for what goes unsaid", "check": "insight, dc_fair", "learn": "{grief}",
      "yes": "It is in how {priest} says 'down there': not as doctrine, but as a place someone went.",
      "no": "Whatever goes unsaid, you do not see it." },
    { "id": "grief", "label": "Speak to {priest} of the brother who went down", "needs": "knows(actor, {grief})", "check": "persuasion, dc_easy", "won": true,
      "yes": "{priest} looks at you a long time. 'He went down into {name} and no one went after him,' says {priest}. 'If you are going, go after him too.'",
      "no": "{priest} turns away. 'You know nothing about it,' says {priest}, and that is the end of it." },
    { "id": "lie", "label": "Tell {priest} the keepers of names sent you to see to {opened}", "check": "deception, dc_hard", "won": true, "caught": true,
      "yes": "{priest} looks at you for a long moment, and nods. 'Then see to it,' says {priest}.",
      "no": "{priest} looks at you for a long moment. 'The keepers send their own,' says {priest}. 'Get out of my shrine.'" },
    { "id": "threat", "label": "Tell {priest} {opened} will be opened whatever is said", "check": "intimidation, dc_fair", "won": true, "caught": true, "always": true,
      "yes": "{priest} goes white, and tells you what you came to hear, to be rid of you. There will be nothing more for you from this shrine.",
      "no": "{priest} is not afraid of you. 'Then open it without me,' says {priest}, 'and bury your own dead.'" }
  ],
  "promise": { "label": "Promise {priest} to shut {opened} again when you come back up",
    "yes": "{priest} takes your hand in both hands. 'Then I will hold you to it,' says {priest}. {told}" },
  "broken": "{priest} looks past you at the door. 'You promised to shut it again,' says {priest}, and nothing more to you, then or after.",
  "shut": "{priest} will not look at you. The shrine is shut to whoever opened {opened} against its word."
}

      "workplace": { "id": "reedbeds", "name": "the reed-beds", "scene": "The reed comes right up to the last houses, and paths are cut into it, and bundles stand in ricks on the hard ground like a camp of small grey tents." },
      "seen": ["{Name} is binding a bundle of reed with a twist of itself, and stacking it on the rick.", "{Name} is up to the knees in water, cutting reed with a sickle, and singing to it under {their} breath."],
      "talk": ["'Best reed is winter reed,' says {Name}. 'Cut it when your hands are too cold to feel the sickle. That's how you know.'", "'Every roof from here to the hills is our reed,' says {Name}. 'You've slept under some of it, I'd bet.'"], "knows": ["water"] },
    "thatcher": { "name": "thatcher", "background": "thatcher", "painting": "builder", "trades": ["reed"], "sizes": ["village", "town"],
      "seen": ["{Name} is up a ladder against a roof, beating reed into place with a wooden bat.", "{Name} is sorting spars on the ground, splitting hazel with a hook."],
      "talk": ["'A good roof lasts longer than the man who made it,' says {Name}. 'A bad one lasts longer than his good name.'", "'Mind the eaves,' says {Name}. 'I'm not paid to catch anyone.'"] },
    "salt_boiler": { "name": "salt-boiler", "background": "laborer", "painting": "smelter", "trades": ["salt"],
      "workplace": { "id": "saltpans", "name": "the salt-pans", "scene": "Low sheds over shallow lead pans, fires under them, and white steam going up off the brine. The ground is crusted grey and crunches." },
      "seen": ["{Name} is raking salt to the edge of a pan and lifting it out with a wooden scoop.", "{Name} is feeding the fire under a pan with peat, coughing in the steam."],
      "talk": ["'Brine in, fire under, salt out,' says {Name}. 'Sounds easy. Try it with wet peat.'", "'The whole country eats our salt,' says {Name}, 'and we get the coughs.'"] },
    "peat_cutter": { "name": "peat-cutter", "background": "laborer", "painting": "gatherer", "trades": ["peat", "salt"], "terrains": ["marsh", "frost"],
      "seen": ["{Name} is stacking turves to dry, in little leaning towers.", "{Name} is cleaning a long narrow spade, the turf-iron, with a handful of grass."],
      "talk": ["'You cut it in spring and burn it in winter,' says {Name}. 'If you cut it in winter you'll burn it in spring and freeze in winter.'", "'Things come up out of the moss,' says {Name}. 'A butter-keg once. A wooden spoon. A hand, my uncle said. He drank.'"] },
    "woodcutter": { "name": "woodcutter", "background": "woodcutter", "painting": "feller", "trades": ["timber", "charcoal"], "terrains": ["forest"],
      "seen": ["{Name} is splitting logs on a block, each one in two strokes.", "{Name} is sharpening an axe on a wheel, testing the edge on {their} thumbnail."],
      "talk": ["'Oak for the wrights, ash for the wheel, birch for the fire,' says {Name}. 'And hazel for everything else.'", "'You don't go into the old wood without leave,' says {Name}. 'Not leave from the reeve. Leave.'"], "knows": ["wood"] },
    "charcoal_burner": { "name": "charcoal-burner", "background": "laborer", "painting": "collier", "trades": ["charcoal"],
      "workplace": { "id": "clamps", "name": "the charcoal clamps", "scene": "Two domed clamps of turf smoke on a cleared floor beyond the houses. The air tastes of tar. A hut of poles and bracken stands by them." },
      "seen": ["{Name} is walking round a smoking clamp, stopping every few steps to listen to it.", "{Name} is asleep sitting up by the clamp, black to the eyes."],
      "talk": ["'A clamp burns five days,' says {Name}. 'You sit up with it like a sick child. Let it flare and you've made ash.'", "'The smiths want it, the salters want it,' says {Name}. 'Nobody wants the one that makes it, mind. Not in the house.'"], "knows": ["wood"] },
    "beekeeper": { "name": "beekeeper", "background": "orchardist", "painting": "gardener", "trades": ["honey"],
      "workplace": { "id": "skeps", "name": "the bee-garden", "scene": "A walled garden of herbs and old fruit trees, with straw skeps along the south wall in niches. The air hums." },
      "seen": ["{Name} is bent over a skep, talking to the bees in a low voice.", "{Name} is pressing comb in a cloth bag, honey running out of it in a thread."],
      "talk": ["'You tell them things,' says {Name}. 'Births, deaths, weddings. They take offence if you don't. I told them about you.'", "'Wax for the shrine, honey for the inn, mead for the reeve,' says {Name}. 'Stings for me.'"] },
    "chandler": { "name": "candle-maker", "background": "craftsman", "painting": "candlemaker", "trades": ["honey", "whale oil"], "sizes": ["village", "town"],
      "seen": ["{Name} is dipping a rack of wicks into a tub of tallow, slowly, again and again.", "{Name} is trimming a candle with a knife, and lighting it to see."],
      "talk": ["'Tallow for the houses, wax for the shrine,' says {Name}. 'The gods like the good stuff.'", "'Every light in {place} after dark is mine,' says {Name}. 'Think of that when you're reading.'"] },
    "quarrier": { "name": "quarrier", "background": "stone_mason", "painting": "quarrier", "trades": ["slate"], "terrains": ["mountain"],
      "workplace": { "id": "quarry", "name": "the quarry", "scene": "A quarry face of blue-grey slate rising behind the settlement, with ledges cut into it and heaps of spoil below like spilled books." },
      "seen": ["{Name} is splitting slate with a broad chisel, each sheet coming away with a sound like a page turned.", "{Name} is sitting on a heap of spoil eating bread and onion, grey to the eyebrows."],
      "talk": ["'Every roof in three valleys,' says {Name}. 'Slate keeps the rain off and lasts forever. Which is bad for business.'", "'The old face is closed,' says {Name}. 'Something in the rock. You hit it and it rings. Nobody likes the note.'"], "knows": ["stone"] },
    "miner": { "name": "tin-miner", "background": "miner", "painting": "prospector", "trades": ["tin"],
      "workplace": { "id": "adit", "name": "the mine-head", "scene": "The black mouth of an adit in the hillside, with a little wooden frame over it, a pile of ore beside, and water running out of it orange." },
      "seen": ["{Name} is coming up out of the adit with a basket of ore on {their} back, blinking.", "{Name} is washing ore in a sluice, picking through the grit with quick fingers."],
      "talk": ["'Dark, wet and low,' says {Name}. 'And that's the good level.'", "'The old people had the tin first,' says {Name}. 'We keep breaking into their workings. Their props are better than ours.'"], "knows": ["stone"] },
    "smelter": { "name": "smelter", "background": "smith", "painting": "smelter", "trades": ["tin"], "sizes": ["village", "town"],
      "seen": ["{Name} is pumping a bellows with a foot, slow and steady, watching the colour of the fire.", "{Name} is pouring a little bright run of tin into a mould, holding {their} breath."],
      "talk": ["'Tin and copper, nine to one,' says {Name}. 'Get it wrong and the bell rings flat. Everyone knows whose fault it is.'"] },
    "trapper": { "name": "trapper", "background": "hunter", "painting": "trapper", "trades": ["furs"], "terrains": ["frost", "forest"],
      "seen": ["{Name} is stretching a pelt on a frame of withies, scraping it with a blade.", "{Name} is oiling a row of snares and laying them out in order."],
      "talk": ["'Marten, fox, beaver if you know the water,' says {Name}. 'Wolf if the wolf is careless, which is never.'", "'You learn a beast by its road,' says {Name}. 'Same as people. They all go home the same way.'"], "knows": ["wood"] },
    "furrier": { "name": "furrier", "background": "skinner", "painting": "furrier", "trades": ["furs"], "sizes": ["village", "town"],
      "seen": ["{Name} is sewing a collar of grey fur with tiny stitches, the needle going in and out of sight.", "{Name} is blowing into a pelt to see the colour at the root."],
      "talk": ["'A good pelt is winter-caught,' says {Name}. 'Summer fur sheds in your hands. People try to sell me summer fur. People are fools.'"] },
    "whaler": { "name": "whaler", "background": "sailor", "painting": "whaler", "trades": ["whale oil"], "water": true,
      "workplace": { "id": "tryworks", "name": "the try-works", "scene": "On the shore below the houses, great iron pots on stone hearths, black with use, and the ribs of a whale bleaching beside them on the shingle." },
      "seen": ["{Name} is scraping a try-pot clean with a long iron, cursing it fondly.", "{Name} is coiling a line on the shingle, looking out to sea more than at the rope."],
      "talk": ["'One whale lights the country for a winter,' says {Name}. 'We go out for three and come back with one and are glad of it.'", "'The big ones talk,' says {Name}. 'Under the boat. You feel it in your teeth.'"], "knows": ["water"] },
    "ice_cutter": { "name": "ice-cutter", "background": "laborer", "painting": "ice-cutter", "terrains": ["frost"], "water": true,
      "seen": ["{Name} is sawing a block out of the ice with a long-toothed saw, and the water under it is black.", "{Name} is loading blocks of ice onto a sledge, wrapped in straw."],
      "talk": ["'The ice-house keeps it till midsummer,' says {Name}. 'Then the reeve has cold beer and the rest of us have chilblains.'"], "knows": ["water"] },
    "herbwife": { "name": "herb-wife", "background": "herbalist", "painting": "herbalist", "everywhere": true, "pronoun": "she",
      "seen": ["{Name} is hanging bunches of something grey-green to dry from a line under the eaves.", "{Name} is grinding something in a stone mortar, sniffing it now and then."],
      "talk": ["'Yarrow for a cut, feverfew for the head, willow bark for a fever,' says {Name}. 'The willow grows by water, if you want to know. Everything good does.'", "'I've nothing left,' says {Name}. 'Half {place} has had the cough. If you're going anywhere damp, bring me back what grows there.'"], "knows": ["herbs", "water"], "concern": "herbs" },
    "midwife": { "name": "midwife", "background": "nurse", "painting": "midwife", "sizes": ["village", "town"], "pronoun": "she",
      "seen": ["{Name} is sitting in a doorway in the sun with {their} eyes shut, catching up on a night.", "{Name} is washing linen in a tub, sleeves rolled to the shoulder."],
      "talk": ["'Every soul in {place} under forty, I caught,' says {Name}. 'I don't let them forget it.'", "'Up all night with the Hayward child,' says {Name}. 'A girl. Loud. She'll do.'"] },
    "reeve": { "name": "reeve", "background": "beadle", "painting": "reeve", "sizes": ["village", "town"],

      "talk": ["'Somebody has to say whose turn it is to clear the ditch,' says {Name}. 'That's me. I'm much loved for it.'", "'The lord's man comes at quarter-day for the rents,' says {Name}. 'And for anything else he can find. Keep your head down when he's here.'"] },
    "sexton": { "name": "sexton", "background": "acolyte", "painting": "deacon", "sizes": ["town"],

    "fiddler": { "name": "fiddler", "background": "minstrel", "painting": "fiddler", "sizes": ["village", "town"],

      "talk": ["'A net's mostly holes,' says {Name}. 'It's which holes that matters.'", "'They tear it, I mend it, they tear it,' says {Name}. 'Seals, mostly. Sometimes my own family.'"] },

      "talk": ["'Everyone thinks the miller cheats,' says {Name}. 'Everyone was right about the last one. Not me.'", "'When the stream's low the stones go slow, and so does everything in the village,' says {Name}. 'You can tell a dry year by the bread.'"] },
    "lay_brother": { "name": "lay brother", "background": "acolyte", "painting": "friar", "foundings": ["monastery"], "pronoun": "he",

      "talk": ["'The brothers pray and we dig,' says {Name}. 'Some days I think we've got the better of it.'", "'We're to be silent before the noon bell,' says {Name}, 'which it isn't, quite, so I'll be quick.'"] },
    "soldier": { "name": "soldier of the garrison", "background": "soldier", "painting": "soldier", "foundings": ["fortress"], "knows": ["roads"],
      "seen": ["{Name} is leaning on a spear in the shade of the wall, watching nothing in particular with great attention.", "{Name} is polishing a helmet that will never be any shinier."],
      "talk": ["'Nothing comes up the pass,' says {Name}. 'That's the job: making sure nothing comes up the pass. I'm very good at it.'", "'Pay's late, beer's thin, and the sergeant's my uncle,' says {Name}. 'Could be worse. Could be the other side.'"] },

    "shimmering_veil": { "where": "wild", "name": "the veil", "verb": "Pass through", "seen": "A veil of light hangs between two rocks here like a sheet put out to dry, and through it the country beyond looks a little different.", "taken": "For a breath you are somewhere else, and you come back marked with a ward you cannot see.", "after": "There is no veil, only air." },
    "singing_crystal": { "where": "within", "name": "the singing crystal", "verb": "Touch", "seen": "A crystal grows out of the rock here, tall and clear, and hums very faintly, the way a glass does when a wet finger goes round its rim.", "taken": "It sings when you touch it, a long high note that stays in you and lifts your heart.", "after": "The crystal is dumb." },
    "spectral_figures": { "where": "wild", "name": "the grey figures", "verb": "Follow", "seen": "Figures go by here in a line, grey and silent, walking somewhere. They take no notice of you. You can see the hill through them.", "taken": "They go before you without a sound and turn once to look at you, and you carry yourself after it like someone who has been looked at.", "after": "The figures are gone." },
    "time_dilation": { "where": "wild", "name": "the slow place", "verb": "Step into", "seen": "On a stretch of ground here the grass bends to a wind you cannot feel, and the clouds over it go faster than clouds anywhere else.", "taken": "The world outside slows to a crawl.     "unearthly_silence": { "where": "wild", "name": "the silence", "verb": "Stand in", "seen": "A silence lies over this place that is more than quiet.     "whispering_voices": { "where": "within", "name": "the whispering wall", "verb": "Listen at", "seen": "Voices whisper in the walls here, too low to make out, as if a roomful of people were talking next door. data/kits/raider-hold/cave/hold.kyr:
Module cave_hold "A cave hold" {
  Description "A cave in a hillside behind a screen of brambles: a mouth where the watch sits, a smoky cavern, a ledge up a notched log where the chief sleeps, a pit for captives, a dry side-cave for plunder, a crack that looks out over the road, and a chimney that comes out on the hillside above.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place land "The region" is region.
  Place outside "The approach" is room.

  Place lair "the cave" is site within land.
  Place mouth "the cave mouth" is room within lair at 0, 1.
  Place cavern "the smoky cavern" is room within lair at 1, 1.
  Place ledge "the high ledge" is room within lair at 1, 0.
  Place pit "the captives' pit" is room within lair at 2, 1.
  Place cache "a dry side-cave" is room within lair at 2, 0.
  Place crack "the spy-crack" is room within lair at 0, 0.
  Place hillside "the hillside above the cave" is room within lair at 1, 2.
  Initially Assert unlit(pit). Initially Assert unlit(cache). Initially Assert unlit(crack). Initially Assert indoors(cavern).

  Passage brambles "the brambles across the cave mouth" is passage between outside and mouth taking 10 minutes.
  Passage cave_throat "the throat of the cave" is passage between mouth and cavern.
  Passage notched_log "a notched log" is climb between cavern and ledge.
  Passage pit_rope "a rope ladder down into the pit" is climb between cavern and pit.
  Passage cache_crawl "a crawl into the side-cave" is crawl between cavern and cache.
  Passage crack_way "a cleft in the wall" is passage between mouth and crack.
  Passage chimney "the chimney" is climb between cavern and hillside taking 30 minutes hidden until backway_known needing climbing or rope.
  Passage hill_path "a goat-track down the hillside" is path between hillside and outside taking 20 minutes.

  Observe mouth_scene at mouth when true "The cave mouth, behind its brambles: a fire-blackened ceiling, gnawed bones, and a stool for whoever keeps watch.".
  Observe cavern_scene at cavern when true "A big smoky cavern with a fire in the middle and the smoke going up into a black hole in the roof. A notched log leans against the wall up to a ledge; a rope ladder hangs into a pit.".
  Observe ledge_scene at ledge when true "A ledge high in the cavern wall, out of the smoke: a bed of skins, and a chest.".
  Observe pit_scene at pit when true "A pit with sheer sides and a muck floor. You would not climb out of it without the rope.".
  Observe cache_scene at cache when true "A dry side-cave stacked with plunder.".
  Observe crack_scene at crack when true "A cleft in the rock that looks straight down on the road below.".
  Observe hillside_scene at hillside when true "The open hillside above the cave. Smoke comes out of a hole among the rocks.".
  Observe chimney_hint at cavern when not knows(party, backway_known) "The smoke goes up the hole in the roof as if it had somewhere to go.".

  Thing chest "a chest on the ledge" at ledge {
    Holds.
    State locked closed "A chest stands on the ledge, locked.".
    State open "The chest on the ledge stands open.".
    Change pick "Pick the chest's lock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change smash "Break the chest open" from locked to open needing brawn.
  }
  Thing heap "a heap of plunder" at cache {
    Holds.
  }
  Discovery backway_known "The smoke-hole in the cave's roof is a chimney that comes out on the hillside above; a climber could go up or down it." {
    Found by searching cavern "Up the smoke-hole there is daylight, and a crack worn by hands and feet: a chimney, and someone climbs it.".
    Found by searching outside with woodcraft "Up the hillside, smoke comes out of a hole among the rocks, and there is a goat-track to it.".
    Found by searching hillside "Among the rocks the smoke comes out of a crack you could climb down, with a rope or a good grip.".
  }
  Goal false.
}
data/kits/raider-hold/ringfort/hold.kyr:
Module ringfort "A ring-fort" {
  Description "An old earth ring on a rise: a ditch and a bank topped with stakes, a stake gate, a yard, a long hall roofed with turf over a store-pit, a lookout mound, and a souterrain from the pit that comes out among the gorse below.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place land "The region" is region.
  Place outside "The approach" is room.

  Place fort "the ring-fort" is site within land.
  Place under "Under the hall" is level within fort.
  Place ditch "the ditch under the bank" is room within fort at 0, 2.
  Place yard "the yard inside the ring" is room within fort at 1, 1.
  Place hall "the long hall" is room within fort at 1, 0.
  Place den "the far end of the hall" is room within fort at 2, 0.
  Place pens "the pens" is room within fort at 2, 1.
  Place mound "the lookout mound" is room within fort at 0, 1.
  Place gorse "a hole among the gorse" is room within fort at 2, 2.
  Place pit "the store-pit" is room within under at 1, 0.
  Initially Assert unlit(pit). Initially Assert indoors(hall). Initially Assert indoors(den).

  Passage bank_path "the path up the bank" is path between outside and ditch taking 20 minutes.
  Passage stake_gate "the stake gate" is gate between ditch and yard.
  Passage hall_door "the hall door" is door between yard and hall.
  Passage hide_curtain "a curtain of hides" is doorway between hall and den.
  Passage pen_hurdle "the pen hurdle" is gate between yard and pens.
  Passage mound_steps "the steps up the mound" is steps between yard and mound.
  Passage pit_ladder "the ladder down into the store-pit" is ladder between hall and pit.
  Passage souterrain "the souterrain" is crawl between pit and gorse taking 30 minutes hidden until backway_known.
  Passage gorse_path "a way out through the gorse" is path between gorse and outside taking 20 minutes hidden until backway_known.

  Observe ditch_scene at ditch when true "A deep ditch under a bank of turf, and along the top of the bank a fence of stakes as tall as a man. Things hang from the stakes and turn in the wind: bones, rags, a doll.".
  Observe yard_scene at yard when true "The yard inside the ring is trodden mud, with a long turf-roofed hall, a hurdle pen, and a mound with a lookout's seat on top.".
  Observe hall_scene at hall when true "The long hall is low and smoky, with a fire in a pit down the middle and sleeping-straw along the walls. A ladder goes down through a hole in the floor at one end.".
  Observe den_scene at den when true "The far end of the hall, behind hides: a heap of fleeces like a throne, and a chest.".
  Observe pens_scene at pens when true "Hurdle pens, mucky, full of somebody else's sheep.".
  Observe mound_scene at mound when true "From the top of the mound you can see the road for miles, and anyone on it.".
  Observe pit_scene at pit when true "A pit under the hall, roofed with timber, full of plunder. In the far wall a low stone-lined passage goes off into the dark, and a draught comes down it that smells of gorse.".
  Observe gorse_scene at gorse when true "A hole among the gorse below the ring, half hidden, worn smooth at the lip.".

  Thing chest "a chest under the fleeces" at den {
    Holds.
    State locked closed "The chest under the fleeces is locked, with a padlock as big as a fist.".
    State open "The chest under the fleeces stands open.".
    Change pick "Pick the chest's padlock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change smash "Smash the chest's padlock" from locked to open needing brawn.
  }
  Thing heap "a heap of plunder" at pit {
    Holds.
  }
  Discovery backway_known "A passage leaves the ring-fort's store-pit and comes out in a hole among the gorse below the ring." {
    Found by searching pit "The draught comes from a souterrain, a stone-lined crawl going off under the bank.".
    Found by searching outside with woodcraft "Among the gorse below the ring, a hole worn smooth at the lip, and the smell of smoke coming out of it.".
  }
  Goal false.
}

  Kind element.
  Entity fire: element "fire". Entity cold: element "frost". Entity lightning: element "lightning".
  Entity acid: element "acid". Entity poison: element "poison". Entity necrotic: element "blight".
  Entity radiant: element "radiance". Entity force: element "force". Entity sonic: element "thunder".
  Entity psychic: element "dread".
  Relation exposedTo(place, element).
  Goal false.
}
data/rules/passages.kyr:
Module world_passages "Passages, obstacles and the condition of things" {
  Kind passage. Kind condition. Kind change. Kind thing. Kind waykind. Kind hazard.
  // What is seen and changes but is not handled: the weather, a river, a beacon on a far hill.
  Kind scenery.
  Relation passageKind(passage, waykind). Measure travelTime(passage).
  // The ways that are road (a road, a bridge, a ford on one), and the way a company last went by.
  Relation roadway(passage). Relation tookWay(group, passage) exclusive.
  // A way walked in less than a watch: how many minutes (see ActionTime.minutes).
  Measure travelMinutes(passage).
  // A way that opens only while something holds (Passage … opening when …), while it does not.
  Relation unopened(passage).
  Relation connects(passage, place, place).
  Relation on(entity, passage).
  Relation guards(group, passage).
  Relation state(entity, condition) exclusive.
  Relation blocksWhen(entity, condition). Relation harmsWhen(entity, condition).
  Relation hurtsWith(entity, hazard). Relation hurtsInto(entity, condition).
  Relation revealedBy(entity, fact).
  // Containment: a thing or item inside another, reachable while that one is not shut; a receptacle can take more.
  Relation inside(entity, entity). Relation receptacle(entity). Relation closesWhen(entity, condition).
  // A hazard that strikes a company: the world turns it on one of its members (a trap sprung, a stone that falls).
  Relation strikes(hazard, group).
  // What can be tried on a thing (looked over closely, prodded, pried at...), and what has been.
  Kind verb. Relation probeable(entity). Relation suits(entity, verb). Relation tried(entity, verb).
  Relation needs(entity, entity).
  Relation changeOf(change, entity). Relation changeFrom(change, condition). Relation changeTo(change, condition).
  // A change only one side reaches (the bar on the cellar side of a door) is made from that place.
  Relation changeAt(change, place).
  Query placedFor(a: group, c: change) means not changeAt(c, ?p) or (changeAt(c, ?p) and at(a, ?p)).
  Relation changeKnows(change, fact). Relation consumes(change, good). Relation spends(change, itemkind).
  Relation hobbled(group).
  Relation following(group, group).
  Query holding(a: group, k: itemkind) means memberOf(?m, a) and ownedItem(?i, ?m) and itemKind(?i, k).
  // Carrying a particular thing: this key, not any key.
  Query carries(a: group, i: entity) means memberOf(?m, a) and ownedItem(i, ?m).
  // What a way or a change needs: a skill, a kind of thing, or one particular thing.
  Query meets(a: group, n: entity) means capable(a, n) or holding(a, n) or carries(a, n)
    or (following(a, ?l) and holding(?l, n)).
  Query equippedFor(a: group, x: entity) means not needs(x, ?n) or (needs(x, ?n) and meets(a, ?n)).
  Query informedFor(a: group, c: change) means not changeKnows(c, ?f) or (changeKnows(c, ?f) and knows(a, ?f)).
  Query visibleTo(w: passage, a: group) means not revealedBy(w, ?f) or (revealedBy(w, ?f) and knows(a, ?f))
    or (revealedBy(w, ?g) and following(a, ?l) and knows(?l, ?g)).
  Query barred(w: passage) means (on(?o, w) and state(?o, ?s) and blocksWhen(?o, ?s)) or unopened(w).
  // Who holds the key to what bars a way, and those who serve them, go through it as if it were open.
  Relation keyholder(group, entity).
  Query opens(a: group, o: entity) means keyholder(a, o) or (serves(a, ?m) and keyholder(?m, o)).
  Query barredFor(w: passage, a: group) means on(?o, w) and state(?o, ?s) and blocksWhen(?o, ?s) and not opens(a, ?o).
  Query watched(w: passage) means guards(?g, w) and able(?g) and state(?g, ?t) and blocksWhen(?g, ?t)
    and at(?g, ?p) and connects(w, ?p, ?q).
  Query obstructed(w: passage) means barred(w) or watched(w).
  Query watchedAgainst(w: passage, a: group) means guards(?g, w) and able(?g) and state(?g, ?t) and blocksWhen(?g, ?t)
    and at(?g, ?p) and connects(w, ?p, ?q) and not allied(?g, a) and not tolerates(?g, a).
  Query hazardous(w: passage) means on(?h, w) and state(?h, ?s) and harmsWhen(?h, ?s).
  // Something that can do harm, in a state where it does none: a trap gone off, or one made safe.
  Query harmless(t: entity) means harmsWhen(t, ?h) and state(t, ?s) and not harmsWhen(t, ?s).
  // Something that can bar a way or shut something in, in a state where it does neither: a seal broken, a lid off.
  Query undone(t: entity) means (blocksWhen(t, ?b) and state(t, ?s) and not blocksWhen(t, ?s))
    or (closesWhen(t, ?c) and state(t, ?z) and not closesWhen(t, ?z)).
  Query mobile(a: group) means not hobbled(a) or following(a, ?l).
  Query together(a: group, b: group) means at(a, ?p) and at(b, ?p).
  Query shut(c: entity) means state(c, ?s) and closesWhen(c, ?s).
  // A thing hidden until something is known is not there, for a company that does not know it; nor is a thing on a way
  // the company does not know of.
  Query onHiddenWay(x: entity, a: group) means on(x, ?w) and not visibleTo(?w, a).
  Query noticed(x: entity, a: group) means (not revealedBy(x, ?f) or (revealedBy(x, ?f) and knows(a, ?f)))
    and not onHiddenWay(x, a).
  Query reaches(a: group, t: entity) means noticed(t, a) and ((at(a, ?p) and at(t, ?p))
    or (at(a, ?q) and on(t, ?w) and connects(?w, ?q, ?r))
    or (at(a, ?q) and guards(t, ?w) and connects(?w, ?q, ?r) and at(t, ?r))
    or (at(a, ?h) and inside(t, ?c) and at(?c, ?h) and not shut(?c))).
  Query passable(w: passage, a: group) means visibleTo(w, a) and not barredFor(w, a) and not watchedAgainst(w, a)
    and not hazardous(w) and not unopened(w)
    and equippedFor(a, w).
  Goal false.

  Action go(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place) "Take {way} to {destination}" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and passable(way, actor)
      and mobile(actor).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert at(actor, destination). Assert tookWay(actor, way). }
    Seen "{actor} takes {way} toward {destination}.".
  }
  Action slip_past(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place, gatekeeper: group) "Slip past {gatekeeper} by {way}" {
    Description "Someone who moves quietly takes the company past a watcher without a fight or a bargain. The watcher stays where it is, and will be there on the way back.".
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and guards(gatekeeper, way)
      and able(gatekeeper) and state(gatekeeper, ?t) and blocksWhen(gatekeeper, ?t) and not tolerates(gatekeeper, actor)
      and (at(gatekeeper, origin) or at(gatekeeper, destination))
      and capable(actor, stealth)
      and visibleTo(way, actor) and not barred(way) and not hazardous(way) and equippedFor(actor, way) and mobile(actor).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert at(actor, destination). Assert tookWay(actor, way). }
    Result "One at a time, keeping low and downwind, you slip past {gatekeeper}.".
  }
  Action risk(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place, trap: entity, blow: hazard, after: condition, victim: member) "Risk {trap}; {victim} goes first" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and on(trap, way)
      and state(trap, ?s) and harmsWhen(trap, ?s) and hurtsWith(trap, blow) and hurtsInto(trap, after)
      and memberOf(victim, actor) and awake(victim) and visibleTo(way, actor) and not obstructed(way)
      and equippedFor(actor, way) and mobile(actor).
    Resolve expose(blow, victim).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert state(trap, after). Assert at(actor, destination). Assert tookWay(actor, way). }
    On failure { Assert state(trap, after). }
  }
  Action change_thing(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition) "{how}" {
    Time 3 minutes.
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and placedFor(actor, how) and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and not consumes(how, ?g) and not spends(how, ?k).
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). }
  }
  Action change_thing_spending(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition, spent: item, form: itemkind, carrier: member) "{how}, using {spent}" {
    Time 3 minutes.
    Description "What it takes is used up doing it.".
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and placedFor(actor, how) and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and spends(how, form) and memberOf(carrier, actor) and awake(carrier)
      and ownedItem(spent, carrier) and itemKind(spent, form).
    Resolve drop(spent, carrier).
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). }
    // Said by the thing's own name ("the Abbess's Eye is used up", not "Elen's the Abbess's Eye").
    Result "{spent} is used up.".
  }
  Action change_thing_paying(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition, spent: good) "{how}" {
    Time 3 minutes.
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and placedFor(actor, how) and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and consumes(how, spent) and quantity(actor, spent) >= 1.
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). Decrease quantity(actor, spent) by 1. }
  }
}
